app_fee.value: Standard UTokyo graduate entrance examination fee is JPY 30,000 for regular doctoral entrance examinations (e.g., IST, Medicine, GSFS); Special International Graduate Programs such as Science (GSGC / Special Selection) and Engineering (IME / Civil International Program) charge JPY 10,000 and override this centrally.
app_fee.quote: Graduate (excl. School of Law) | Examination fee | ¥30,000

fee_waiver.value: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship recipients are exempt from examination, admission, and tuition fees; self-financed international applicants cannot obtain an upfront application/examination fee waiver based on financial need (post-enrollment admission/tuition exemptions are handled separately under tight budgets).
fee_waiver.quote: Note: Students receiving a scholarship from the Japanese government (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology) do not need to pay tuition and certain other fees.

also.quote: This system provides full or partial exemption from admission/tuition fees for those who are approved after screening based on their application.

gre_general.value: UTokyo sets no university-wide GRE General policy; requirements are decided by each Graduate School and department (required by Engineering IME and most Science GSGC departments, not stated or omitted in IST, Mathematical Sciences, GSFS, and Medicine).

toefl_min.value: UTokyo has no university-wide minimum TOEFL score; each Graduate School sets its own English proficiency requirement (for example, Medicine Doctoral expects TOEFL iBT new score 3.5 / former 60, whereas IST, Engineering, Science, and GSFS specify no numerical floor).

ielts_min.value: UTokyo has no university-wide minimum IELTS score; IELTS Academic is accepted alongside TOEFL in certain Graduate Schools (such as Engineering IME, Medicine International Health, and GSFS GPSS), whereas IST and Science GSGC require TOEFL.

english_waiver.value: English proficiency waiver rules are set separately by each Graduate School rather than centrally (ranging from No waiver in IST and Science [native-speaker exemption only] to Conditional institutional MOI certificate waivers in Engineering IME, Medicine International Health, and GSFS GPSS).

notes: QS WUR 2027 #39. Covers all 18 STEM PhD fields across the Graduate Schools of Science, Mathematical Sciences, Information Science and Technology (IST), Engineering, Frontier Sciences (GSFS), and Medicine (primarily Hongo, Komaba, and Kashiwa campuses in Greater Tokyo). Admission fee is JPY 282,000 and standard graduate annual tuition is JPY 535,800 (JPY 520,800 for certain doctoral cohorts). Most regular Japanese-system doctoral exams require a Master's degree, while Science GSGC provides a 5-year integrated Master's-to-Doctoral English track from a bachelor's degree.
